name: Lock N Roll Storage
summary: Lock N Roll on Earl Rudder Freeway lists climate rooms, interior rooms, a drive-up 10x10, and vehicle parking. Checked Nov 22, 2026, the unit cards show the monthly rate and do not print a separate move-in fee. The company pricing page still says there is no admin fee beyond a small lock fee, and it does not print that lock amount.
address: 1501 Earl Rudder FWY, College Station, TX 77845

fees.label: Administrative fee
fees.per: at move-in, not printed on the unit card
fees.note: On Nov 21, 2026 the unit list added $24 at move-in. Checked Nov 22, 2026, the unit cards show the monthly standard rate and do not print $24 or any move-in fee. The company pricing page still says there are no setup or admin fees beyond the first month and a small lock fee. That lock amount is not published, so the $24 figure is unverified.

facts.label: Climate control
facts.value: The facility page lists both climate-controlled and non-climate storage, plus drive-up units.

facts.label: Sizes
facts.value: The facility page says unit sizes run from 5x5 to 10x30. The unit list also includes parking spaces that are not copied into the room table.

facts.label: Students
facts.value: The page mentions student storage near Texas A&M and summer storage so students do not have to haul belongings home.

facts.label: Lease and reservation
facts.value: Month-to-month leases. The page says you can reserve online for free with no credit card.

facts.label: Other features
facts.value: Deliveries accepted, dollies, moving supplies, boat and RV storage, covered parking, a gate, and U-Haul trucks on site.

facts.label: Office and access hours
facts.value: The page has headings for today's office hours and today's access hours. The times are not listed. Call before you plan to get in.

gaps: Lock fee amount. The company page mentions a small lock fee and does not print it.
Parking and covered vehicle prices are on the same unit list and are not copied here.
